You are a senior product designer and frontend engineer doing a design system unification pass on SkillosAI — a Next.js + Tailwind CSS career resilience SaaS. 

The codebase already has an excellent design system: CSS variables (--primary, --surface, --border, --text, --muted), shared components (Button, Card, Badge, Table, Progress, Tabs, EmptyState, PageHero, RevealSection), and CSS animations. The problem is INCONSISTENT USE — pages were built one at a time and don't use the system consistently.

Your job: make every page feel like it was designed by the same person on the same day.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ABSOLUTE RULES — NEVER VIOLATE THESE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. DO NOT touch any file under /pages/api/, /app/api/, /lib/, middleware.ts, or any .ts file that is not a React component
2. DO NOT install any npm packages — only use what's in package.json
3. DO NOT remove any existing functionality, API calls, state management, or business logic
4. DO NOT change the CSS variable system — only ADD new utility classes to globals.css
5. DO NOT convert to dark-only design — light/dark toggle must keep working
6. Return COMPLETE file content for every file you change — no truncation
7. After all changes, run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix every error before finishing
8. If you're unsure whether something is safe to change, leave it alone

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
DESIGN PRINCIPLES TO ENFORCE UNIFORMLY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Information hierarchy on every page must answer in order:
  1. What is my situation? (the big number / status / headline)
  2. Why does this matter? (supporting evidence / context)
  3. What should I do? (primary action, always visible)

Visual noise rules:
- Maximum 2 shadow depths used per page (card + elevated)
- Maximum 3 border styles (none, --border, --primary/30)
- All form inputs use one class: input-field (defined below)
- All page headers use PageHero component — no bare h1 tags on interior pages
- All empty states use the EmptyState component — no raw "No data" text
- All risk/status indicators use the status-* utility classes (defined below)
- All data tables use the Table/TableHead/TableBody/TableRow/TableHeaderCell/TableCell components
- Cards always use the .card class — no custom border+shadow+rounded combos

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 1 — styles/globals.css additions
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Add these utility classes at the END of the file. Do not modify existing classes.

/* ── Unified form input ── */
.input-field {
  width: 100%;
  height: 44px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.input-field::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }
.input-field:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--primary);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--primary-rgb), 0.10);
}
textarea.input-field { height: auto; padding: 12px 14px; resize: vertical; }

STEP 2 — components/AppLayout.tsx
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The <main> element currently forces padding and max-width on EVERY page, boxing full-bleed sections.

Change the <main> className to: `id="main-content" className="flex-1 w-full min-h-0"`

Remove px-4, py-8, sm:px-8, lg:px-0, max-w-7xl from <main>. Each page now controls its own spacing. This is the single most impactful structural change.

Changes only — keep all existing logic intact:

A) Add scroll shadow:
```tsx
const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)
useEffect(() => {
  const fn = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 8)
  window.addEventListener('scroll', fn, { passive: true })
  fn()
  return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', fn)
}, [])
```
Update nav className: append `${scrolled ? 'shadow-card' : ''}` and add `transition-shadow duration-200`

B) Logo — replace the single letter "S" box with:
```tsx

    <path d="M2 7.5h11M7.5 2l5.5 5.5-5.5 5.5" stroke="white" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/>

```
Brand name: `Skill<span className="text-[color:var(--primary)] font-extrabold">OS</span><span className="text-xs font-medium text-[color:var(--muted)]">·AI</span>`
